note: Model arms and matrix for the OpenRouter benchmark. Prices and supported parameters are from the public catalog snapshot of 2026-11-23; re-check them with `python -m experiments.preregister catalog` before freezing. Changing an arm's pin makes it a new arm (its arm id changes, so earlier runs are not counted for it). After editing, regenerate the schedule and re-freeze.

phases.P1: pre-pilot, unscored (experiments/runs/pilot): every arm x pilot_cases via `batch --pilot`
phases.P2: main A, headline Q1-Q5: hidden faults + healthy
phases.P3: main B, parity Q2: visible faults

token_model.note: Per-run token estimates; the pre-pilot replaces them with measured usage.

spend_guard.note: The batch starts no run when the recorded spend of all arms (pre-pilot included) plus that run's reservation would exceed global_budget_usd (the OpenRouter key limit is $5.50; $0.25 margin). Pre-pilot spend counts against each arm's cap. Per-run reservation: the token-model worst case until the arm has a completed paid run, then max(worst case, observed_run_factor x its highest observed run cost). A run whose cost was not recorded (agent killed or crashed first) counts at the reservation, or at its audited cost if larger.

arms.effective_temperature: provider default: temperature is not a supported parameter on this endpoint, so the requested 0.2 is ignored

novita-fp8.note: pre-registered cost-switch alternative; a new arm id glm@novita-fp8

wafer-fp4.note: UNVERIFIED: provider slug and price; fill both from the catalog snapshot before selecting this pin

cost_switch.rule: If GLM's median cost per run in the pre-pilot exceeds threshold_median_usd_per_run, then before the main phase either set pin to alternative_pin (a new arm id) or set decision to 'accept' (GLM may stop early at its cap). The batch refuses the main phase until one is recorded.

crusoe-bf16.note: price assumed equal to novita; confirm in the catalog snapshot

free.note: free variant only; no provider is pinned (its slug is not in the offline snapshot). max_price 0/0 makes OpenRouter refuse any paid route; allow_fallbacks false

arms.data_collection_note: user-approved 2026-11-23 for this free arm only (free endpoints may log or train on prompts; prompts are synthetic logs and container names); every other arm stays 'deny'

free_tier.note: 50 requests/day while lifetime purchases are below $10 (1,000/day at $10 or more; override with batch --free-requests-per-day). The day is UTC. accepted_served_models is the exact model string replies and the generation audit should report. Its base id (without ':free') and dated variants ('<base>-YYYYMMDD', with or without ':free') are accepted only when every call reported exactly $0, the zero-cost guard was on and the generation audit confirmed $0 for every generation; anything else halts the arm.

arms.effective_temperature: provider default: temperature is not a supported parameter on this endpoint
